card.name: MBq radioactivity unit after numbers
card.fires_on: The piece 'MB' that begins the radioactivity unit MBq (megabecquerel), right after a number or slash in radiopharmaceutical dose or dosimetry text.

modes.label: Dose amounts
modes.description: MB in MBq after a number or range of administered activity, often followed by mCi in brackets.

modes.label: Dosimetry per unit
modes.description: MB in MBq after a slash in radiation dose per activity tables.

card.plain: It marks the start of the unit MBq when a radioactive dose is written, as in 370-1110 MBq.
